scope: Own-family source qualification for direct external CH1-4 capture and CH1/CH2 quadrature modes 1/2/3, buffered GTIM and ATIM only. Read-only source study; no silicon verification, no HAL tests or harnesses.

encoder_sms.1: TI1FP1 edges, direction from TI2FP2; x2
encoder_sms.2: TI2FP2 edges, direction from TI1FP1; x2
encoder_sms.3: Both TI1FP1 and TI2FP2 edges; x4

encoder_constraints: CC1NP=CC2NP=0; P controls inversion, never both-edge capture encoding in encoder mode.
CR1.DIR updated by hardware on either input transition, including transitions that do not clock the selected x2 mode.
Counter uses 16-bit CNT and ARR; wraps between 0 and ARR.
CCxS is writable only with its CCxE=0; IC prescaler resets immediately while CCxE=0.

implementation_inferences.text: Hold exclusive ownership of each timer; disable CEN and all capture/interrupt/DMA enables before programming. Reset stale timer configuration, set GPIO AF input (not output), TISEL=0 and TI1S=0, set direct mapping while CCxE=0, configure polarity/filter/PSC/ARR/CNT, issue only UG if required to load buffered PSC, clear stale flags after UG, then enable relevant channels and start CEN last.

For encoder set PSC=0 and input prescalers=0, edge-aligned mode, SMS low bits=1/2/3 with SMSH=0 and ECE=0; clear index/reset configuration and use ARR=0xffff unless an explicit modulus is requested. Start at a defined CNT and read DIR as hardware status.

Drop/cancel must mask interrupt and DMA enables, disable capture channels, stop CEN, and only then release GPIO/timer ownership. Stopping CEN alone is not documented to disable capture events: CCxE is the capture gate.

Each CCR is a single most-recent capture latch, not a FIFO. No source supports lossless capture at the electrical fEXT limit through polling/interrupt service. Reading CCR clears CCxIF; an extra ICR clear of CCxIF after the read can discard a newly arriving event. Preserve and report overcapture, and do not promise coherent sample/overflow association under racing input.
Count and direction reads are not an atomic snapshot. A u16 wrapping count is not an absolute long-range position. Delayed software sampling cannot reconstruct arbitrary numbers of wraps.

No indirect TI mapping, TRC/internal source capture, reset/PWM-input, index input, alternative encoder SMS values, ATIM CH5/6, complementary CHxN pins, capture DMA, or wake-from-sleep behavior is qualified by this batch.

GTIM_EncodeInit in all three SDK sources is inside #if 0 and uses older CR0/CMMR registers. Do not reuse it for these buffered timers. GTIM SDK polarity enum 1/2/3 is not direct hardware NP/P; ATIM uses 0/1/3.

CW32L010 raw SDK route PA0 AF7 = ATIM CH4 is physically documented but excluded from the qualified route dataset due to OSC_IN ownership. PB0/PB1 ATIM CH1/2 likewise excluded for OSC32 ownership. Do not silently add these from the raw candidates; no safe CH4 route exists in current qualified L010 data.
